verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI's own MCP client docs say it can connect to MCP servers and use their tools during an agent run, which is exactly this story. Its agent model also treats toolsets as a first-class part of an agent. Missing for 10: details on transports and server configuration, tool filtering or approval for MCP tools, and independent or hands-on corroboration of MCP client use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: Pydantic AI can act as an MCP client, connecting to MCP servers to use their tools as part of an agent run.
